integrity: The proof and self-contained exact-rational Python checker are embedded. Finite checks test definitions and arithmetic, not infinite statistical assertions.
scientific_limitations: Integral Hare quota only; no assertion about Droop core, core+, or fractional deviations.
Independence across voters is essential to the stated Chernoff tail bound; approvals within each ballot may be correlated.
The exact total-variation threshold is a sharp distribution-free uniform sufficient condition, not a necessary condition for every individual approval law.
Fixed-size asymptotics follow if the symmetry bound is uniform in voter count; growing dimensions require evaluation of the explicit finite bound.
A scientific literature comparison cannot exclude all unindexed equivalent results.
title: Sharp candidate-symmetry tolerance for universal approval-core stability
